desc: Reduce the game to parity-based state and justify exact A_i values beyond parity are irrelevant.
Derive final winner condition: N=1 Fennec; N=2 Snuke; N=3 Fennec iff any A_i is odd; N>=4 Fennec iff the number of odd A_i is odd.
Implement the O(N) Python solution reading stdin and printing Fennec or Snuke.
Validate edge cases and performance, including samples and small brute-force cross-check.
